description: TEDAstro bir gelecek projesi olan Türk Eğitim Derneği'nin geleceğe bakan yüzüdür.
summary: Uzayın Kayıp Yolcuları is a student-created storytelling project inspired by NASA’s records of objects left behind in space. Through an illustrated children’s book and a short animation about a lost golf ball, the team tells the story of an object continuing its journey in space. The project invites young audiences to learn about space history and imagine the stories behind objects left beyond Earth.
details: Our project, “Passengers Lost in Space,” turns NASA’s records of objects left behind in space into a story for young audiences. The team created an illustrated children’s book and a short animation about a golf ball lost in space. Through storytelling, the project helps children explore space history and imagine the journey of an object left beyond Earth.
